body: Follow-up from the S24-06 deadlock fix: RunBodyCrawler always re-paged the full discovery history on every restart (harmless but wasteful, grows slower every day). Added CrawlerConfig.CursorPath persisted to var/prwatch-body/.cursor, same idiom as eps-processor/guidance-watcher/dividend-watcher. Verified live: cursor round-tripped correctly across two real restarts (513 -> resumed from 513). Also found and fixed a real .gitignore bug while committing: /prwatch (meant for a stray build binary) was shadowing the real prwatch/ source package directory, silently blocking new files from git add without -f -- same class of bug as the earlier DIS unanchored-dis/ fix. Commits c8b2c03, b9c113b, 836e8a9.
title: prwatch-body cursor persistence + gitignore shadow fix
